message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files and calls clear_data() which only drops constant columns, but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded only from local filesystem paths (pd.read_csv with a local path); there is no remote source fetching, so no checksum verification or authentication is applicable or present.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains models from scratch using tree model functions (lgb_reg, xgb_reg, etc.) and does not load any pretrained serialized model weights, so no integrity verification is applicable or implemented.

No detected label distribution validation: The code uses KFold/StratifiedKFold for splitting but performs no explicit class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) or mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While cross-validation splits are used, there is no held-out test set isolated from training, no signed/hashed evaluation data, and no explicit mechanism to prevent metric manipulation or leakage.

No detected input sanitization: The code reads CSV files and applies basic data cleaning (clear_data removes constant columns, delete_nan/replace_nan handle missing values) but there are no shape/range checks, schema validation, or rejection of malformed inputs before passing data to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is present that checks model outputs for NaN values, out-of-range probabilities, or any sanity bounds before returning or displaying predictions.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses tree-based ML models (LightGBM, XGBoost, Random Forest, Extra Trees) for tabular data, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and not implemented.
